en.quote: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
en.riddle: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father
en.speaker: Joseph

bonus_hint.quote: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

he.quote: וַיְצַו יוֹסֵף אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אֶת־הָרֹפְאִים לַחֲנֹט אֶת־אָבִיו וַיַּחַנְטוּ הָרֹפְאִים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
he.riddle: וַיְצַו יוֹסֵף אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אֶת־הָרֹפְאִים לַחֲנֹט אֶת־אָבִיו
he.speaker: יוֹסֵף

bonus_hint.quote: וַיֹּֽאמֶר־לוֹ אֱלֹהִים שִׁמְךָ יַעֲקֹב לֹֽא־יִקָּרֵא שִׁמְךָ עוֹד יַעֲקֹב כִּי אִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

en.2: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
